messages:
maria: Quick sketch — proposing 'windowed metering' as a new billing mode to smooth commit/usage noise. Idea: compute customer commitments on a rolling 30d window (configurable), tie tiering to that baseline instead of calendar-month buckets. Less hair for customers during short spikes. PTAL :eyes:

sam: interesting. two quick ops questions: 1) how does this change invoicing/reporting? 2) can we switch customers mid-cycle without messy credits?

maria: short answers: 1) invoicing still emits monthly bill, but the meter that feeds it uses the rolling baseline. we surface both "window baseline" and "current month" in reports. 2) we provide a migration path; no automatic retroactive charge changes — opt-in migration or a one-time migration credit if needed.

jyoti: product detail — what happens to add-ons and burst policies? e.g., today add-ons are defined as X tokens/month over baseline. does windowing change definitions?

maria: plan is: keep realtime throttles & burst tokens as-is for latency/SLAs. Billing definitions: baseline = rolling window average; add-ons = percent over baseline measured against the window. So bursts still allowed, but charges settle against windowed baseline. That keeps runtime simple.

tom-biz: Sales POV: customers will like predictability. must add Console visibility (projected spend) and a simple explainer. Also pilots will ask for an "effective date" to model contract terms.

pricing-bot: heads-up — any change to meter semantics triggers legal/compliance review and a 60-day customer notice requirement.

sam: engineering notes: prototype plan — expose a meter API: `GET /v1/customers/{id}/commitment_window?days=30` returning baseline scalar + breakdown. Backend: sliding window counter + aggregation job. I estimate 2 sprints for core, plus 1 sprint for reporting/console hooks.

jyoti: suggested launch criteria (concise): 1) migration playbook 2) console projection widget 3) billing regression tests (simulation + backfill) 4) legal notice template 5) 2 pilot customers signed up -> label `v1-windowed-metering`.

maria: Agree with those criteria. Next steps: I'll draft RFC + migration playbook. @tom-biz please surface 2 pilot customers who'd accept a short pilot and share historical usage. I'll put a short demo on next week's roadmap review. :rocket:`
